publisher_correlation: All four source families are NCERT; subject/chapter roots are distinct, but publisher and curriculum dependence remain.

items.subject: english
items.passage: The order has come from Berlin to teach only German in the schools of Alsace and Lorraine.
items.stem: According to this sentence, which change was ordered for the schools in Alsace and Lorraine?
options: French would remain the only language taught.
German would become the only language taught.
Both languages would stop being taught.
Students could choose any language to study.

support.decisive_evidence: The excerpt states that only German is to be taught in the schools named.

syllabus.clause: Reading Comprehension: literary passages, maximum 300 words.

items.subject: accountancy
items.stem: Which term describes the portion of issued capital that the public has actually subscribed?

support.decisive_evidence: NCERT defines subscribed capital as issued capital actually subscribed by the public.

syllabus.clause: Unit IV: Company Accounts; share capital meaning, nature and types.

items.subject: business_studies
items.stem: A firm compares available finance sources by cost and risk, then plans how to use the funds. Which function is it carrying out?

support.decisive_evidence: The chapter defines financial management as optimal procurement and usage of finance, including comparing sources by cost and risk.

syllabus.clause: Unit IX: Business Finance; role and objectives of financial management.

items.subject: economics
items.stem: A consumer's total utility rises from 40 units after 6 units of a good to 46 units after 7 units. What is the marginal utility of the seventh unit?

support.decisive_evidence: NCERT defines marginal utility as the change in total utility from one additional unit; 46 minus 40 equals 6.

syllabus.clause: Course I, Unit I: Theory of Consumer Behaviour; consumer equilibrium through the utility approach.
